storylines.title: Spot the Phish
storylines.summary: The three red flags in a phishing email and how to check a link safely.

beats.voiceover: One wrong click can hand over your whole inbox.
beats.caption: One click. Big loss.

clip.title: A man talking while typing on laptop

beats.voiceover: Phishing emails fake urgency, a name you know, and a link that is almost right.
beats.caption: Urgency + fake sender

beats.voiceover: Hover the link, read the real domain, and never type a password from an email.
beats.caption: Check the real domain

beats.voiceover: If a message rushes you, slow down and verify through the official site.
beats.caption: Slow down. Verify.

clip.title: Man writing on clipboard while looking at screen

post.caption: Phishing works by rushing you. Slow down, check the real domain, and never enter a password from an email.

storylines.title: The Missed-Delivery Text
storylines.summary: Fake delivery and bank texts (smishing) and the one rule that stops them.

beats.voiceover: That delivery text may be fake.
beats.caption: That text is a scam

beats.voiceover: They ask for a small fee and your card to reschedule a parcel you never sent.
beats.caption: Small fee = big theft

beats.voiceover: Real couriers do not text for card details. Open their app, not the link.
beats.caption: Use the app, not the link

beats.voiceover: Report the message and delete it. Never reply to a scam text.
beats.caption: Report, don't reply

beats.voiceover: GEM Enterprise helps you set up alerts and safer habits, scoped first. Check eligibility at gemcybersecurityassist.com.
beats.caption: Get a review →

post.caption: That 'missed delivery' text is a scam. Real couriers never text for card details - use their app, not the link.
